completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting building codes and regulations

1. Identify the relevant building codes and regulations for the project.
2. Research and analyze the specific building codes and regulations applicable to the project.
3. Determine which codes and regulations are most relevant to the project.
4. Create a list of all the relevant codes and regulations, including any citations.
5. Document any existing building codes or regulations.
6. Document any additional requirements outlined in the regulations.
7. Document any applicable exceptions to the code or regulation.
8. Document any required documentation to be submitted to the local building department.
9. Document any waivers that may be obtained for certain requirements.
10. Document any penalties that may occur if the regulations are not followed.
11. Document any testing and inspection requirements outlined in the regulations.
12. Document any electrical requirements outlined in the regulations.
13. Document any plumbing requirements
